repos_data.description: An open-source, self-hostable PaaS alternative to Vercel, Heroku & Netlify that lets you easily deploy static sites, databases, full-stack applications and 280+ one-click services on your own servers.
Provision, secure, backup, and manage self-hosted servers — full lifecycle, one CLI.
MCP server for Coolify — 64 tools to deploy, diagnose, and manage apps, databases, and services on your self-hosted PaaS. OpenAPI-generated schemas, docs search, secrets masked by default.
